cases.note: The question asked every cycle while a controller holds a motion, which is why it is a second function rather than a branch of the first: one is asked once per request and this is asked at the control rate.

The instant the deadline falls is still inside it. A controller that answers exactly on time has answered on time — §87.4's lease takes the same reading, and the two being the same is worth a case in each.
And the first instant it is not. Abort the motion, enter §27's fault path, and record it — which is what stands in for a watchdog that has nothing to watch.
